request.title: Prove the dominated convergence criteria of §11.1.1 (Ch11 Sec1a sweep)
request.body:
Sweep of `RiemannMasullo/Ch11_ShellStructure/Sec1a.lean`: both open proofs are **proved**; the file has no `sorry` left. Only proofs and `private theorem` helpers; no statement changed.

Closes #4699
Closes #4702

- `tendsto_eLpNorm_ideleThetaSum_of_dominated` (Proposition 11.1.1.2(2), p. 476): on the Borel set the theta functions converge pointwise to the limit theta sum (termwise convergence plus the uniform-tails hypothesis), and both are bounded by the majorant orbit sum, so `‖Θ_k − Θ‖ₑ^r ≤ ‖2·majorant‖ₑ^r`, which is integrable because the majorant is in Lʳ. Lebesgue's dominated convergence then gives `∫⁻ ‖Θ_k − Θ‖ₑ^r → 0`, hence `eLpNorm → 0`.
- `tendsto_adelicTheta_of_dominated` (Corollary 11.1.1.4, p. 478): `Θ c := ideleThetaSum f c.out`, which is well defined since the idele theta series is invariant under principal translation (reindexing over `Fˣ`). Every class has a representative in `e '' (univ ×ˢ E₁)` by `ideleFundamentalDomain_cover` (Proposition A.2.3.10(2)) and `he_one`; at that representative the uniform tails give convergence.

Helpers (private, directly above the declaration they serve): a Tannery-type lemma (termwise convergence + uniformly small `ℓ¹` tails ⇒ convergence of the sums), the pointwise convergence on `Z`, principal invariance of `ideleThetaSum`, and the covering of ideles by principal translates of the section times the norm-one domain.

Checks run:
- `lake build RiemannMasullo.Ch11_ShellStructure.Sec1a` after each proof, and `lake build` of every module that imports it (`Sec1a_Printed`, `Sec1b`, `Sec1b_Printed`): pass. A full library `lake build` was not run in this sandbox (it is unchanged below this file).
- `scripts/lint.sh`: ok.
- Signatures of the module before/after (`scripts/Signatures.lean` on this module, then `scripts/signatures.sh --compare`): no changed statements.
- `#print axioms`: both theorems depend on `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` only.
